description: Main window: core defaults, the read-only `api` command, the two report stage commands (approve_report, revoke_report) and the note archive command (archive_note), the user column score command (score_column), the table page memory edit command (edit_memory) and the skills install of the Setup screen (install_skills), which run src/stageCli.js, the Setup screen's setup_init, which creates ~/.auspex and an example profiles file only when absent, and its save_connection, which runs src/stageCli.js with the connection on stdin to write one profile and one pgpass line. No shell or other process plugin.
